title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria - The final temperature of the water must be correctly identified as 0°C.

title: Ice Melted Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The amount of ice melted must be calculated correctly using the heat absorbed and the heat of fusion.

title: Work Done Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The work done by the engine must be accurately computed based on the heat absorbed and expelled.

title: Heat Transfer Understanding
description: Important Criteria - The reasoning behind the heat transfer process and the relationship between the temperatures must be clearly explained.

title: Efficiency Concept
description: Important Criteria - The concept of efficiency reaching zero at the end of the process should be correctly applied.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - Units should be consistently used throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Common errors such as sign mistakes in the calculations should be avoided.

title: Heat of Fusion Usage
description: Pitfall Criteria - The heat of fusion value must be correctly applied in the calculations.
